```python
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def task_func(array_length=100):
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    if isinstance(array_length, bool) or not isinstance(array_length, (int, np.integer)):
        raise ValueError("array_length must be a positive integer.")
    if array_length <= 0:
        raise ValueError("array_length must be greater than zero.")

    array1 = np.random.random(array_length)
    array2 = np.random.random(array_length)

    statistics = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "Array1": [
                np.mean(array1),
                np.median(array1),
                np.std(array1),
            ],
            "Array2": [
                np.mean(array2),
                np.median(array2),
                np.std(array2),
            ],
        },
        index=["Mean", "Median", "Standard Deviation"],
    )

    x = np.arange(len(statistics.index))
    width = 0.35

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
    ax.bar(x - width / 2, statistics["Array1"].values, width, label="Array1")
    ax.bar(x + width / 2, statistics["Array2"].values, width, label="Array2")

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(statistics.index)
    ax.set_xlabel("Statistics")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")
    ax.set_title("Comparison of Array Statistics")
    ax.legend()

    plt.tight_layout()
    return statistics, ax
```
